These are observed results and simple averages. They are separate from the opponent-adjusted power rating. Only metrics with collected data appear in this explorer.

Individual game5-game average7-game average

Left to right: games in date order. Green: each game's value. Orange starts once 5 complete observations are available; blue starts after 7. Each rolling point uses that game's result and the preceding 4 or 6 games. Hover or focus a dot for its date, opponent and value; the same values are in the game log.

Summary tiles can show partial averages, with counts. Graph rolling lines and window-to-window changes require complete observations: 10 games for five versus five, 14 for seven versus seven. Missing values stay missing. Percentages pool their numerators and denominators. These postgame histories must be lagged before use in a pregame forecast.

Ranking factors

Factors start enabled, with rest days off. Fitted adjustments respond immediately in the comparison above and on the rankings page in this browser. Data needed or insufficient sample means no estimated adjustment is applied. Adding a custom idea does not create data or a fitted coefficient.
